description: SIDEWAYS FIX. The error was all vertical because horizontal and vertical errMax were equal (30deg each) and vertical is far more visible (ball into turf / skied) while a few degrees sideways just looks like a slightly wide pass. Also corrects a mislabelled patch: 0x14401a12c is the HORIZONTAL sign probability (params+0x14 sits in the +0x10 = angleXZ block), not the vertical one — it had been biasing all sideways misses to ONE side; reverted to 50/50 so slices go both ways. Now horizontal 60deg vs vertical 20deg.

patches.name: VERTICAL error 30 -> 20 deg (stop the up/down dominating)
revert accidental one-sided horizontal bias (50 -> 100 = slices both ways)
